question: The mutual inductance $M$ between two coils depends on their relative orientation. Under which condition is the mutual inductance between two coils maximum?

options.A: When the axes of the two coils are perpendicular to each other.
options.B: When the coils are placed far apart.
options.C: When one coil is wound over the other sharing a common axis.
options.D: When the coils are inclined at 45 degrees to each other.
